attribution.metaDescription: PantryButler uses open-source projects and open data. Learn about our data sources and their licenses.
attribution.title: Attribution & Licenses
attribution.intro: PantryButler is built on the shoulders of giants. We use several open-source projects and open data sources to provide you with the best recipe management experience.

cooklang.description: Cooklang is a markup language for cooking recipes. It provides a simple, human-readable format for writing recipes that can be easily parsed and displayed in various formats. PantryButler uses Cooklang-inspired syntax for ingredient parsing and recipe formatting.

gridRecipe.description: Grid Recipe renders recipes as a grid of steps, with arrows showing the flow of ingredients through each step. PantryButler's grid recipe feature is inspired by this open-source project.

openFoodFacts.description: Open Food Facts is a free, open, collaborative database of food products from around the world. It contains information about ingredients, nutrition facts, labels, and more. PantryButler may use Open Food Facts data for ingredient information and nutritional data.

openNutrition.description: OpenNutrition provides a comprehensive, open database of food and nutrition information. The dataset includes detailed nutritional information for thousands of foods, including macronutrients, micronutrients, vitamins, and minerals. PantryButler uses OpenNutrition data to display nutritional information for recipes when this feature is enabled.
openNutrition.licenseLabel: License: Open Database License (ODbL) + Modified Database Contents License (DbCL)
openNutrition.attributionLabel: Attribution: Data provided by OpenNutrition. Portions of this data incorporate information from Open Food Facts.
openNutrition.requirementsLabel: Requirements: Attribution must be provided on every interface where nutrition data is displayed, in application store listings, on the website, and in legal/about sections.

licenseCompliance.title: License Compliance
licenseCompliance.description: PantryButler is committed to complying with all open data licenses. We provide proper attribution to all data sources and respect the terms of their respective licenses.
licenseCompliance.contactNote: If you have questions about our use of these data sources or believe we are not in compliance with any license terms, please contact us.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: Welcome to PantryButler. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our application.

accountInfo.title: Account Information
accountInfo.intro: When you create an account, we collect:

appData.title: Application Data
appData.intro: When you use PantryButler, we store:
items: Comments and likes on public recipes

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
items: Provide and maintain the PantryButler service
Authenticate your account and ensure security
Store and sync your recipes, pantry items, and meal plans
Enable social features like recipe sharing and comments

storageSecurity.title: Data Storage and Security
storageSecurity.intro: Your data is stored securely using encrypted transmission and industry-standard security practices. We implement security measures including:
items: Per-instance access control that limits data visibility to authorized members
storageSecurity.note: While we strive to protect your data, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

sharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data only in these circumstances:

publicRecipes.text: When you choose to make a recipe public, it becomes visible to all users

serviceProviders.text: With our infrastructure providers for hosting and data storage

legalRequirements.text: If required by law or to protect our rights

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR Compliance)
rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:

access.text: Request a copy of your personal data

erasure.text: Request deletion of your personal data

restrictProcessing.text: Limit how we use your data

dataPortability.text: Receive your data in a structured format

object.text: Object to certain types of data processing

rights.note: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through the settings page or email us directly.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.text: We use essential cookies and local storage to maintain your session and remember your preferences (such as language and theme settings). We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.text: PantryButler is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.text: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. If you delete your account, we will delete your personal data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it for legal purposes.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.text: Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data in accordance with this privacy policy.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us through:
items: The Settings page in the application
